memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Now the earth was formless and empty, darkness was over the surface of the deep, and the Spirit of God was hovering over the waters. - Gen 1:2 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Before God shaped the world into the beautiful place we know, it was formless, empty, and dark. Nothing was in order yet. It was like a blank canvas waiting for the artist's hand.

But look closely, even then, God was not distant. The Spirit of God was hovering over the waters, present and ready to act. The word used here gives the picture of a bird gently watching over its nest. God was near to the emptiness, preparing to bring life and order out of it.

Perhaps your life feels a little like that today, empty in places, dark in others, with things that seem out of order. Take heart. The same Spirit who hovered over that dark deep is at work in the lives of God's people. Where we see only confusion, God sees what He is about to do.

This is how God works throughout Scripture, He brings light out of darkness and order out of chaos. And He does it supremely through Christ, in whom we become a new creation (2 Cor 5:17). The God who did not abandon the formless earth will not abandon you. He is patient, present, and powerfully at work, even in the waiting.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Where in your life does everything feel formless or dark right now?
2. Can you trust that God's Spirit is near, even before you see any change?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that You are present even in my empty and uncertain places. By Your Spirit, bring order, light, and life where I need it most. Amen.
